title: The Doom Slayer's pet rabbit Daisy in DOOM
subject: doomslayer
description:
Had you ever heard of Daisy before? 👇

The story of Daisy, the pet rabbit behind the Doom Slayer's endless war, from The Ultimate Doom to DOOM Eternal. Spoilers for The Ultimate Doom.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by id Software or Bethesda Softworks. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: The Doom Slayer's war started over a pet rabbit named Daisy.
In 1995, The Ultimate Doom added a fourth episode called Thy Flesh Consumed.
After beating Hell there, he came home to find Earth on fire.
The last picture showed Daisy's head on a stake, and the text promised someone would pay for what happened to Daisy, your pet rabbit.
That ending led straight into Doom II: Hell on Earth.
Decades later, Doom Eternal hid a painting of Daisy for players to find.
Every demon he ripped apart since then has been paying for one rabbit.
